**1 — Scene:** A modest serving of cooked grains with browned tofu-like cubes and vegetables, alongside a small leafy salad. The cubes could be cheese, but tofu is my best visual estimate.

**2 — Vessel:** A rounded rectangular dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Using a 27 cm circular equivalent gives an estimated area of **572 cm²**. Food on neighboring plates is excluded.

**3 — Items:** Cooked brown grains, browned tofu, mixed salad leaves, thin radish/onion/carrot slices, cooked vegetables mixed into the grains, and a small pale creamy dressing beneath the salad. Any cooking oil is included in the cooked items’ energy estimates rather than counted separately.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Areas below partition the visible food footprint without double-counting overlaps.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density → weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked grains | 20% | 114 × 1.8 = 206 ml | 0.8 → 165 g | 150 | 248 kcal |
| Browned tofu | 10% | 57 × 1.6 = 92 ml | 0.95 → 87 g | 180 | 157 kcal |
| Salad leaves | 12% | 69 × 2 = 137 ml | 0.15 → 21 g | 20 | 4 kcal |
| Thin raw vegetable slices | 3% | 17 × 0.7 = 12 ml | 0.6 → 7 g | 30 | 2 kcal |
| Cooked mixed vegetables | 4% | 23 × 1.5 = 34 ml | 0.6 → 21 g | 60 | 13 kcal |
| Creamy dressing | 2% | 11 × 0.5 = 6 ml | 1.0 → 6 g | 300 | 18 kcal |

**8 — Sanity check:** Estimated coverage is **51%** of the plate. The total of **about 307 g and 442 kcal** fits the visible grain-and-tofu pile plus a light salad. The main uncertainties are the identity of the cubes and the amount of cooking oil.
